name: Avenging the Fallen
summary: Huntsman Markhor of Revantusk Village says the Wildhammer train gryphons to slay trolls, and he wants the elder gryphons of the region, the Skylords, wiped out. You are to slay a Razorbeak Skylord and bring its plume back to him.

sections.title: Slaying the Skylords
sections.body: Markhor, a huntsman of Revantusk Village in the Hinterlands, is bitter that the Wildhammer train gryphons to slay trolls. Justice will come for them, he promises, but first he wants you to turn on the elder gryphons of the region, the Skylords. Slay one and return with its plume. The Razorbeak Skylord is a rare breed that tends to keep to the wilds of the Hinterlands, and Markhor blames it for breeding murderous young.

sections.title: The Plume Examined
sections.body: Markhor looks over the plume and wonders aloud how many hunters the beast devoured before it met justice at your hands.

faq.answer: Huntsman Markhor offers it at Revantusk Village in the Hinterlands.

faq.q: Why does Huntsman Markhor want a Skylord slain?
faq.answer: Markhor says the Wildhammer train gryphons to slay trolls, and he wants the elder gryphons of the region, the Skylords, eradicated. He says the Razorbeak Skylord is a rare breed that breeds murderous young.

faq.q: Where can a Razorbeak Skylord be found?
faq.answer: Markhor says this rare breed keeps to the wilds of the Hinterlands.

faq.q: What must be brought back to Markhor?
faq.answer: Slay a Razorbeak Skylord and return to Markhor with its plume.
